# Weather

Used in [Special rules](/rules/90-special).

::: tip Errata applied
- **E-025** — The Weather Table's season rows are backwards: the game-turn bands belong to the opposite seasons (turns 1-12 are autumn, per the 29.1 calendar and the September 1940 start), so each row's turn bands are swapped with its opposite season's
:::

## Notes

- Values as printed. The chart labels the rows Spring / Summer / Fall / Winter with game-turn bands; SPI's September 1979 errata says the chart is completely backwards and that 29.1's calendar governs. errata/E-025.json rotates the turn bands so that turns 1-12 (the campaign opens in September 1940) are autumn, 13-24 winter, 25-36 spring, 37-48 summer, and so on; the weather dice ranges stay with their season names
- weather[*] is the sequential two-dice reading range (SPI 11.4) rolled in the weather phase; null = that weather cannot occur in that season. A sandstorm or rainstorm result goes on to the Foul Weather Location Table (29.62 / 29.7)
- Season calendar boundaries are in tables/seasons.json (SPI 29.1 with E-024)
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 100) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p6): 0 of 26 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
